{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for presence of 'loyal' in customer_segment
print(f"Unique customer_segment values: {df['customer_segment'].unique()}")

# Check if 'converted' is binary
print(f"Unique values in 'converted': {df['converted'].unique()}")

# Check status column
print(f"Unique values in 'status': {df['status'].unique()}")

# Check if any loyal customers exist
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']
print(f"Number of loyal customers: {len(loyal_df)}")

# Check if 'converted' is 1 for conversions
print(f"Conversion rate among loyal customers (raw): {loyal_df['converted'].mean()}")"}
